summary: Iteration 83: Media Upload / Object Storage System - All features PASSED. Backend APIs (upload, chunked upload, list, download, delete, landing-video) working correctly with real Emergent Object Storage. Frontend MediaManager component renders correctly in Admin Panel with upload, category selector, and file list. LandingPage CommercialVideo section shows/hides correctly based on landing video existence.

minor.issue: Returns 500 instead of 400 for files < 100 bytes (validation error handling)

critical_code_review_comments: Media routes correctly use prefix='/api' and tags=['media']
Storage service properly initializes with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY and caches storage_key
Chunked upload correctly assembles files in /tmp/uploads/{upload_id} and cleans up after
Landing video endpoint filters by category='landing' AND content_type regex '^video/'
MediaManager uses authFetch for API calls but media routes don't require auth (public upload)
CommercialVideo component gracefully returns null when no landing video exists
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted test files during testing (test_upload.txt, test_landing_video.mp4)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 83 verified Media Upload system. Backend: GET /api/media lists files, POST /api/media/upload handles small files, POST /api/media/upload-chunk handles large files (>2MB) with chunked upload, GET /api/media/landing-video returns latest landing category video (has_video=true/false), GET /api/media/file/{file_id} downloads files, DELETE /api/media/{file_id} soft-deletes. Frontend: Admin Panel has Media tab (data-testid='admin-tab-media'), MediaManager component (data-testid='media-manager') has upload button (data-testid='media-upload-btn'), category selector (data-testid='media-category-select'), file input (data-testid='media-file-input'), files table (data-testid='media-files-table'). LandingPage CommercialVideo section (data-testid='landing-commercial') shows video player (data-testid='landing-video-player') when landing video exists.

landing_video_no_video.details: GET /api/media/landing-video returns has_video=false when no video
